root_idea.summary: The root centers on concealment within something and lowering or deepening. Its clearest lexical development is burial: placing the dead into a concealed, lowered place.
root_idea.development: From this orientation come the grave and burial-place, the act of burying, and the causative provision of a place in which someone is buried.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the supported singular place-noun citation form مَقْبَرَةٌ.
Presented under the singular noun citation form قَبْرٌ; the Quran group contains singular and plural inflections.

senses.definition: To provide or assign a grave for someone; to cause someone to be buried.
senses.usage_conditions: Causative Form IV. In the Quranic use, the emphasis is on ensuring a burial place and burial for the dead, rather than merely performing the burial oneself.

senses.definition: A cemetery, burial-place, or place containing graves.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مَقَابِر in the expression حَتَّى زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ is also understood as a conventional euphemism for death.

senses.definition: A grave, tomb, sepulchre, or place where a human being is buried.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural قُبُور refers literally to graves and their contents. In expressions concerning those in the graves, the noun may also metonymically evoke the dead or persons treated as dead; references to what is in the graves can point to the resurrection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bury a corpse; to conceal it in the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the associated aorist and verbal nouns are grammatical variants of this burial sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To order that someone be buried.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form IV causative or directive use distinct from simply providing a grave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To permit burial or give a slain person to others so that they may bury him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical use concerning authorization or release for burial.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To order someone to dig a grave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare attributed Classical interpretation of the Form IV verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lark or other small bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct noun from the burial vocabulary, with variant forms such as قُبَرٌ and قُنْبُرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cemetery or grave keeper; a gravedigger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A masculine occupational adjective applied to a man.
A Classical adjectival use describing land that is deep or difficult to penetrate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A date palm whose yield is borne among its fronds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical description of a date palm and the position of its fruit.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Making or assigning a grave is covered by the Quranic causative sense.
Attributed use meaning ordering a grave to be dug.

cautions: The Quranic group مَقَابِر is presented under the supported singular citation form مَقْبَرَةٌ, while قُبُور is presented under قَبْرٌ.
The bird noun قُبَّرٌ is a separate lexical item from the burial-related words despite sharing the reported consonantal spelling.
